chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
When optional acts stand in the way of obligatories, abandon them.

key_terms.النَّوَافِلُ: Optional or voluntary acts of worship (e.g., Nafl prayers)
key_terms.الْفَرَائِضِ: Obligatory duties or acts of worship (e.g., Fard prayers)

ai.seo_question: What should be done when optional prayers interfere with obligatory prayers?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) establishes a fundamental principle of fiqh where the preservation of the obligatory (fard) takes precedence over the voluntary (nafl), ensuring that spiritual enthusiasm does not lead to the neglect of core duties. This maxim is frequently cited by Shia jurists to resolve conflicts in worship schedules, emphasizing that the integrity of the foundation must not be compromised by the embellishments of supererogatory acts. It reflects the practical wisdom of balancing devotion with responsibility, a key theme in Nahj al-Balagha's ethical teachings.
